loopRoutine.note: Deal each player a starter road card
Deal each player a starter settlement card
Deal each player a hand of 2 resources

1.caption: Each player except those with Longest Road or Largest Army draws 2 cards

2.caption: Player(s) with the most VPs give 1 card to a player with fewer VPs

3.caption: Each player currently exceeding their max hand size discards half their cards

4.caption: Each player draws 1 card; shuffle all event cards

5.caption: Each player draws 1 card per uncovered settlement they own
